we can replace it for free.
teaching.audioText: It is still under warranty, so we can replace it for free.

teaching.en: Would you like to return it or have it repaired?
teaching.es: ¿Quiere devolverla o que la reparen?
teaching.explanationEs: Return es devolver; have it repaired es el servicio de reparación.
teaching.audioText: Would you like to return it or have it repaired?

teaching.en: The other option is to have it repaired for free.
teaching.es: La otra opción es repararla gratis.
teaching.explanationEs: The other option is to + verbo: así se negocia una alternativa.
teaching.audioText: The other option is to have it repaired for free.

teaching.en: Let me check with my manager.
teaching.es: Déjeme consultarlo con mi gerente.
teaching.explanationEs: El vendedor usa manager cuando necesita una decisión superior.
teaching.audioText: Let me check with my manager.

teaching.en: So, to confirm, we will send you a new one on Friday.
teaching.es: Entonces, para confirmar, le enviaremos una nueva el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: To confirm repite lo acordado antes de terminar.
segments: So, to confirm, we will send
you a new one on Friday.
teaching.audioText: So, to confirm, we will send you a new one on Friday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase dice que el producto sigue cubierto por la garantía?

feedback.es: En inglés la garantía se expresa con under warranty. Con with o at la frase no suena natural.

prompt.es: Completa: «Aquí está mi recibo.»

accepted: receipt

feedback.es: El receipt es el papel que prueba la compra y se enseña al pedir una devolución.

hint.es: Es el papel que muestra la compra.

origin.text: Here is my ___.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Podría devolverlo, por favor?»

feedback.es: Could I + verbo base pide permiso con cortesía; please suaviza la petición.

hint.es: Empieza con la forma cortés de pedir permiso.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pide la clienta sobre la lámpara.

choices.text: She wants to return it for a refund.
She wants the shop to repair the lamp.

feedback.es: «Have it repaired» es pedir que la reparen. No habla de devolver el dinero ni de cambiarla.

origin.audio: Hello. I bought this lamp on Monday, and it stopped working yesterday. I would like to have it repaired.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase confirma lo acordado?

choices.text: So, I want to replace the phone on Friday.
So, could you replace the phone on Friday?
So, to confirm, you will replace the phone on Friday.

feedback.es: Confirmar es repetir lo acordado con to confirm y un verbo en futuro. Las otras dos frases piden o expresan un deseo.

origin.text: They agreed: the shop will replace the phone on Friday.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Podría hablar con el gerente?»

accepted: manager

feedback.es: Manager es el gerente: la persona a la que se acude cuando el vendedor no puede resolver.

origin.text: Could I speak to the ___?

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué acuerdan.

choices.text: They will get a new speaker on Friday.
They will give her a refund on Friday.
They will repair it on Friday.

feedback.es: La tienda dice «we can replace it on Friday»: sustituirán el altavoz. No hablan de reembolso ni de reparación.

origin.audio: Mia: Hello, my speaker stopped working after two days. Shop: When did you buy it? Mia: Two days ago. Could I return it? Shop: It is under warranty, so we can replace it on Friday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase resume bien el acuerdo final?

choices.text: The shop will refund the tablet on Monday.
The shop will repair the tablet by Monday.
The customer will repair the tablet by Monday.

feedback.es: El cliente elige la reparación y el plazo es el lunes. Las otras opciones cambian la solución o quién repara.

origin.text: Notes: Faulty tablet. Customer wants a refund. Shop offers an exchange or a repair. Customer chooses the repair by Monday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Otra opción es hacer revisar la batería.»

accepted: checked

feedback.es: Have + the battery + checked: el participio va después de la cosa y otra persona hace el trabajo.

origin.text: Another option is to have the battery ___.

prompt.es: Escribe lo que dices tú en la tienda (90–120 palabras).

answer.text: Hello. I bought this camera last week, and here is my receipt. Unfortunately, it does not turn on, and I used it only twice. Could I return it, please? I see that it is under warranty. I would like an exchange, please, because I need a camera for a trip on Saturday. The other option is to have it repaired, but one week is too long for me. So, to confirm, you will give me a new camera today. Thank you very much for your help, and sorry for the trouble.
accepted: Hello. I bought this camera last week, and here is my receipt. Unfortunately, it does not turn on, and I used it only twice. Could I return it, please? I see that it is under warranty. I would like an exchange, please, because I need a camera for a trip on Saturday. The other option is to have it repaired, but one week is too long for me. So, to confirm, you will give me a new camera today. Thank you very much for your help, and sorry for the trouble.

Hello. I bought this camera on 20 May, and here is my receipt. It does not turn on, and I used it only twice. Could you exchange it, please? I hope we can solve this today. I know I have two options, but I would like the exchange because I need a camera for a trip on Saturday. A repair takes one week, and that is too long. So, to confirm, I will take a new camera today. Thank you for your help.

feedback.es: Una buena respuesta explica el fallo con el recibo, pide con cortesía, elige una opción con una razón y confirma lo acordado.

origin.text: Escena en una tienda: la cámara que compraste hace una semana (recibo del 20 de mayo) no enciende. Pides devolverla. Te ofrecen cambiarla o repararla en una semana. Tú eliges el cambio porque la necesitas para un viaje el sábado, y confirmas. Escribe lo que dirías tú.

evidenceGroups: to confirm you are going to
to confirm i am going to
to confirm we are going to

prompt.es: ¿Qué responde el cliente con cortesía?

choices.text: Then I will never come back.
I see. Could you replace it instead?

feedback.es: El cliente acepta el «no» con I see y propone una alternativa con could you… instead. Las otras respuestas son bruscas.

origin.text: Seller: We cannot give a refund. The customer wants to stay polite.

prompt.es: Completa: «Tengo dos opciones: reembolso o cambio.»

accepted: options

feedback.es: Options es el plural de option; la tienda suele ofrecer dos opciones.

origin.text: I have two ___: a refund or an exchange.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me gustaría cambiarlo, por favor.»

answer.text: I would like to exchange it please

feedback.es: I would like to + verbo base es la forma cortés de pedir algo; please la suaviza.
